findings: Both acceptance-row-1 and row-2 predicates hold exactly on both audited targets (branch bp4/intake@03a4e43d and master@2574de6b) - independently recomputed hashes/bytes match MANIFEST.md in every present-file row, both missing rows correctly reflect on-disk absence.

Acceptance row 2 (header confinement) holds on both targets by a correct, range-aware reading of the diff. A naive hunk-count-only check would still have passed the baseline, but INTAKE-M2 shows it would also silently pass a real violation - the predicate text itself calls for line-range reading, so this is a note on verification methodology, not a defect in the builder's actual work.

Acceptance row 3 is only a presence/anchor check per its literal wording, and both bus posts satisfy it. But the VALUE the branch leg posted ('true') is not honest against its own recorded evidence (2 missing docx), while the harvester's later post ('partial') is honest - this asymmetry is the most substantive finding of the lane.

The master receipt's claim that no leg branch/worktree exists is factually wrong and is contradicted by an adjacent finding in the SAME receipt document (the 'second writer' finding correctly describes a leg that ran in parallel). This looks like a drafting slip in the master receipt rather than a deliberate misstatement, since the receipt elsewhere shows awareness of the branch's work.

The claimed byte-count correction (7168/6451 to 7155/6384) cannot be confirmed or refuted from git history; both committed MANIFEST.md states already carry the corrected numbers. Recorded as unverifiable, not false.
